points.description: States that a variable is a location in memory (named storage location) that can store/hold a value or data.
points.partial_credit: Half or more of the marks if only one half is stated (e.g. 'a container for data' without memory, or 'a memory location' without storing a value), or stated vaguely.

points.description: Makes clear the stored value can be held/changed, i.e. the location stores a value (data) of some kind, using the idea of 'value' or 'data'.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying a variable is a memory location (or named storage in memory) that holds a value, in any wording, even briefly. Part marks if only memory or only storing a value is mentioned, or the idea is vague. No marks for answers that describe something related (e.g. a data type or a function) without the core fact; extra correct detail is fine.
